resources.string: Start calibration, allow the floating control, then follow the tests on your home screen. Judge the actual Super Island: complete text passes, including text the system has reduced in size. Basic calibration aims for about a minute; extra checks appear only when needed. Progress is saved after every answer.
Extra lyric to check (optional, for a new run)
Saved progress: %1$d answers. An unfinished draft does not change your active settings.
Completed: %1$d answers. You can view the result or add detailed checks.
Changing fonts or themes may require a new calibration. Only use a saved setting with its original font and theme.
Check mixed text, spaces and punctuation
Check scrolling and the final glyph
Test %1$d: is all of the sample visible on the right side? Faded or missing glyphs mean incomplete. Drag this header to move the control.
Watch the beginning, middle and end windows. Choose complete only when all are readable and the final glyph appears. The sequence repeats until you answer.
Confirmed CJK capacity: %1$d glyphs; %2$d answers recorded. Apply this result or continue checking. Untested fonts and layouts are not covered.

This is not recorded as clipping. Keep the app in the background and the status bar visible; wait, then replay. If the island still does not appear, pause and check notification and focus-notification permissions.
The shortest sample still cannot be shown in full. Replay or go back to check the answer, or pause and check the display setup.
Progress saved. Continue from the calibration entry when ready.
Draft discarded. Your previous settings remain active.
The display or island layout has changed. Start a new calibration for this environment.
The resume check failed. If the font or theme changed, start a new calibration; otherwise replay from the entry.
Could not save progress. The calibration has stopped; your active settings were not replaced.
Could not start the island test. Progress is saved; check permissions and try again.
Allow display over other apps before starting calibration. The control is removed when you pause or finish.
Super Island is not available in the current device configuration.
Calibration progress and saved settings are separate for these two layouts. This test uses the currently active layout.
The other layout has a saved calibration
It will apply when that progress ring state is active.
Optional. Expand to add a lyric to the new calibration.
